header: External advisors, and where they come from
lead: Portrait, name, affiliation and the subject each one advises on. Two to twelve people, with a note under the grid for the things a board has to say about itself.
note: The note field is the place for declarations of interest, meeting frequency or the sentence explaining that advisors are unpaid.

people.title: The subject is a token
people.text: So a long subject wraps instead of running out of the card
